claude_proposed_widenings.name: area_shape_contiguous_cubes
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Fire Storm's area of effect is 'up to ten 10-foot Cubes' arranged contiguously by the caster at cast time. The current Attachment.area.shape union only contains { kind: 'sphere'; radiusFeet: number }. A cube-based shape variant — minimally { kind: 'contiguous_cubes'; cubeSideFeet: number; maxCubes: number } — is needed to represent this spell without lying about its geometry.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The area of the storm consists of up to ten 10-foot Cubes, which you arrange as you like. Each Cube must be contiguous with at least one other Cube.

discrepancies: no content/fire_storm.json authored; accepted self-report-only widening path
